{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check if the response rate differs by arm
# First, compute response rate for each arm
response_rates = df.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()

# Compute the treatment effect as difference in proportions (treatment - control)
treatment_effect = response_rates['treatment'] - response_rates['control']

# Print results
print(f"Response rates by arm:\n{response_rates}")
print(f"Treatment effect (treatment - control): {treatment_effect}")"}
